releases.name: A Simple Expurriment
releases.summary:
Finding herself in space by hitching a ride with the alien who kidnapped her three kittens, a cat mom will have to use all of her feline traits in order to find them as she evades the security systems that keep looking for her.

A Simple Expurriment is a combatless metroidvania where stealth is key - no big deal for a cat, specially the three kittens that were genetically upgraded to jump higher, become undetectable and so on. But that's not enough when all the security systems are after the elusive cat mom: that's why she also gets the ability to manipulate sections of the building like pieces of a sliding puzzle, allowing her to move through the depths of the Research Area, the perils of the Maintenance Area, the exclusive VIP Area and the scariest place in the galaxy - the corporate cafeteria.

releases.name: Fishcremental
releases.summary: Fishcremental is a ridiculously cozy underwater adventure where you catch super cute fish, discover game-changing upgrades, and fill the whole sea with satisfying firework glory.

releases.name: SWARMED
releases.summary: READY, STEADY, ACTION! Are you ready for ActionRider? Then grab this LITE Version of the spectacular endlessdriver and go for it! Motorcycle or car, it is your choice. Dodge different obstacles and get ActionPoints as much as you can. Go all out with firepower and shoot everything that gets in your way. Collect coins for more Weapons and Upgrades to make the enemy cry! City, Beach, Desert - it doesnt matter where, you got the skill to fight in this ultimate Highscorebattle until you are one of the best driver in the world! ? HD Grafik Retina Display and iPhone 5 Widescreen Support ? 2 Control Options Choose between tilt and touchcontrol with different sensitivities ? Different Vehicles Choose between 6 different colours and types ? Different Weapons Collect coins to get even better weapons and Power Ups ? 2 Leaderboards Compete with the rest of the world via Gamecenter. In Miles or ActionPoints. This Game is also available for iPad ! Support: www.futecvisuals.com Like us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/FutecVisuals or follow us on Twitter: www.Twitter.com/@FutecVisuals

releases.name: Stonk: Timing The Market
releases.summary: Go from being a struggling day trader to running the city. Build out your office and find employees around town to increase your profits. Some of them may have special abilities to manipulate the markets in your favor.

releases.name: Peak: Climb Together
releases.summary: Peak: Climb Together is a physics-based, laughter-filled climbing adventure to play with your friends. As you journey toward the sky, every jump takes you one step closer to the top. But be careful! Falling is only the beginning. Climb your way from the trash all the way to the reward at the peak.

releases.name: Tidy Up Frat House
releases.summary: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

releases.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
releases.summary: Roll the dice.Your dice are always in your hand ready to roll.Gently shake or click 'Roll the Dice' button.

releases.name: Sort Them Cats
releases.summary: Thousands of cats, each with a place! Collect, match, and sort over 4,000 cat figurines in this relaxing organizing game. Unlock helpful abilities, discover hidden surprises, and turn a messy shop into a colorful collection at your own pace.

releases.name: Agastache Rugosa
releases.summary: Have you ever wondered the classic retro style snake game that we used to play on gaming consoles during those old days? The retro style, the sound, the score, these are all our nostalgic memories once we were indulged into this.Here, I'm bringing the same old classic retro style snake game. You will feel the same console color, retro dots, the music, the score etc.The game has five different levels to play with, you can control the speed of the game as well, as you increase the speed, the snake movement will increase.As a snake, your goal is to eat the food, grow yourself as much as with in the retro world. Ensure you are not biting yourself, or biting the walls. As you keep eating the food, your score will increase.So, go ahead and download the game, and get yourself traveled back to your good old school days. :) I'm sure, the game will bring you the nostalgic feelings in you.Please do rate the app, and leave your comments. I would be happy to address your concerns and make the game the best snake game in the store.

releases.name: Broke Wizards
releases.summary: A 1-6 player co-op game where you and your Wizard roommates slay monsters, go racing, play prop hunt or do other crazy jobs to pay rent to your giant Imp Landlord before he eats you.
